scripts.trivy:scan: docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/project:ro -v $(pwd)/../../infra/monitoring/trivy-reports:/reports aquasec/trivy:0.56.2 fs --scanners vuln,secret --include-dev-deps --format json --output /reports/kini-api.trivy.json /project && node ../../infra/monitoring/trivy-json-to-ndjson.js ../../infra/monitoring/trivy-reports/kini-api.trivy.json ../../infra/monitoring/trivy-reports/kini-api-trivy.ndjson kini-api && node ../../infra/monitoring/npm-audit-to-ndjson.js . ../../infra/monitoring/trivy-reports/kini-api-npm.ndjson kini-api
